item.title: Akka Is No Longer Open Source.
item.description: There is a growing number of cases where software companies that started out as open source change their license policy. Lightbend, a US company that had maintained an Apache-2.0 open source license policy, announced in September 2022 that it would change Akka’s license to BUSL-1.1 (Business Source License). Let’s take a look at what the Business Source License is, and what the background and impact are of Lightbend changing Akka’s license to BSL.
